metadata.name: ipow_vault
metadata.description: The iPoW protocol's vault on Solana: vETH, the receipt for ETH locked on Ethereum. Spec: docs/design/ipow-protocol.md, section 11.

accounts.name: mark
docs: the first attest, in the handler.

accounts.name: linked
docs: The claim linked to the attest, when there is one: it must be refused.

accounts.name: fast_pay
docs: The record of this payment: once per burn and stated record. Its
hash is checked against the record by the seeds.

accounts.name: to
docs: the handler.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The program's upgrade authority.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: handler against the upgradeable loader's layout.

accounts.name: mark
docs: missing, in the handler.

accounts.name: linked
docs: The claim linked before, when there is one: it must be refused.

accounts.name: from
docs: For a token: the user's account, the vault's, the mint and its
program.

accounts.name: paid
docs: Once per burn number.

accounts.name: fast_pay
docs: the handler, and empty when nobody paid.

accounts.name: to
docs: handler.

accounts.name: tokens
docs: The vault's account of the token; one per token, so it is registered
once.

accounts.name: prev
docs: is one: it must be settled. Checked in the handler.

accounts.name: to
docs: The true record's recipient: for the rest of the fast fee, or its
receipt when no attest delivered it.

accounts.name: home_asset
docs: For an asset whose home is Solana.

accounts.name: mint
docs: For a receipt: its mint and the vault's account of it.

accounts.name: message
docs: created in the handler.

accounts.name: claim
docs: checked and created only if it opens.

accounts.name: buffer
docs: The transaction and batch, when uploaded to a buffer of the submitter.

types.name: Btc
docs: A Bitcoin transaction in a block below a real block (D108).

fields.name: real
docs: A block already recorded as real, with `block` below it.

types.name: Buffer
docs: A message's Bitcoin transaction and batch, uploaded in pieces when they do
not fit in one Solana transaction with its proof.

types.name: Chain
docs: An operator's pair chain (D106) and what it keeps in the vault.

fields.name: peer_operator
docs: The same operator on Ethereum.

fields.name: slashed
docs: A false record was proven here: every bond is gone (D109).

fields.name: slasher
docs: Who submitted the message proven false: it takes the 20%.

fields.name: refused
docs: A claim of the chain was refused here: no other claim acts (D111).

fields.name: deposits
docs: Lamports for the flat deposits of its claims.

types.name: Claim
docs: The acting records of one message (D111).

fields.name: opened_at
docs: When it opened: an attest waits only for a claim opened in time.

fields.name: payout
docs: Set when decided: what each deposit of the winning side collects.

fields.name: records
docs: The records from Ethereum it acts on, one after the other.

types.name: ClaimAsset
docs: What a claim moves in one asset, and a BOND it carries.

types.name: Config
docs: The vault's one settings record. Its address is the key the vault
registered with the protocol, the authority of every receipt and of the
vault's token accounts, and the holder of SOL: deposits, locked SOL and
SOL bonds.

fields.name: ethereum_vault
docs: The vault on Ethereum, as a registration names it (D106).

fields.name: deposit
docs: D121: the flat deposit to object or answer, and the operator's deposit
for a claim, in lamports.

fields.name: min_certifying_escrow
docs: D118: the least escrow of a job whose proof block counts as real, in
lamports.

fields.name: asset_count
docs: Assets whose home is Solana, SOL being 0 (D128).

fields.name: lock_count
docs: Locks of them.

types.name: Credit
docs: What an address can withdraw in one asset: lamports for SOL, token
units for a token whose home is Solana, a receipt's units for an asset
of Ethereum.

types.name: FastLock
docs: A lock on Ethereum whose receipt an attester issued at once, with the
LOCK record it stated and the receipts it locked (section 11.7, D123).

fields.name: id
docs: Its number: guardians find every attest by it, also one naming a lock
that does not exist.

fields.name: collateral
docs: Receipts locked by the attester, 1.25 times the amount.

fields.name: claim
docs: A claim of the attester's own chain carrying the same record, opened
in time; zero if none (D125).

fields.name: prev
docs: The attest of the same lock made before it, settled first (D126).

types.name: FastPay
docs: A burn on Ethereum of a receipt of an asset here, paid at once by an
attester under the record it stated (section 11.7).

types.name: HomeAsset
docs: An asset whose home is Solana (section 11.9): SOL, number 0, or a token
anyone registered.

fields.name: mint
docs: The default key for SOL.

fields.name: record_decimals
docs: The receipt's decimals, at most 9: records count in its unit.

fields.name: unit
docs: 10 ** (decimals - record_decimals): native units per record unit.

fields.name: reserve
docs: What backs its receipts on Ethereum, in record units: the locks not
returned, less what was paid out, plus the backing share of slashes.

types.name: HomeLock
docs: A lock here of an asset whose home is Solana, for its receipt on
Ethereum (section 11.9).

fields.name: recipient
docs: On Ethereum: an address in the last 20 bytes.

fields.name: fast_fee
docs: For the attester of the fast path, or the recipient (D122).

fields.name: fee_to
docs: The operator of the first true message carrying it, which takes the
fee; default until one does.

fields.name: fee_taken
docs: The fee was taken; the record keeps stating it.

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid the fees and receives them back (D62, D65).

fields.name: commitment_fee
docs: The fee at the price of the moment, and what was sent above the fees

fields.name: claim_kind
docs: 0 for a settlement, otherwise the kind of claim, counted from 1.

fields.name: tip
docs: The block on top of the proof that was shown with it.

fields.name: deepest
docs: The oldest block of the operator's branch asked for and shown (D81).

fields.name: parents_shown
docs: How many parents were shown; the next question is this + 1 (D91).

fields.name: attester
docs: D42: who locked x in the operator's place, if anyone.

fields.name: open_challenges
docs: How many challenges of the job are open.

types.name: LockMark
docs: What became of a lock on Ethereum here. It exists once something
happened, so each happens once.

fields.name: issued
docs: Its receipt counted: issued after its claim, or delivered by an
attest settled with the true record.

fields.name: attests
docs: Attests of the lock (D126), those settled, when its first was made,
and its latest: each names the one before.

types.name: Message
docs: The batch of one processed message, published so that anyone can bring
the message to the other network (D120). Anyone may close it
`MESSAGE_KEPT` after it was processed, its rent back to whoever paid it.

types.name: Paid
docs: A burn on Ethereum of a receipt of an asset here, paid.

types.name: Position
docs: A chain's place in one asset (D129), in record units.

fields.name: bond
docs: Held here: the asset itself when its home is Solana, its receipt
otherwise.

fields.name: stated
docs: The part its BOND record stated.

fields.name: peer_bond
docs: Its bond in the asset on Ethereum, counted once its BOND claim is
official.

fields.name: open_value
docs: Open claims here in the asset.

fields.name: slash_backing
docs: After a slash: the backing's 80%, and the submitter's 20%, not
settled yet.

types.name: Protocol
docs: The single record of the protocol. It holds no key: nothing can change
after deployment (D59).

types.name: Real
docs: A block known to be on real Bitcoin (D108).

types.name: Request
docs: A burn here of a receipt, for the asset on Ethereum (section 11.9).

fields.name: to
docs: On Ethereum: an address in the last 20 bytes.

fields.name: fast_fee
docs: For the attester who pays it at once on Ethereum, or `to` (D122).
Burned with the amount.

fields.name: requested_at
docs: When it was made, in its REQUEST record (D124).

fields.name: fee_to
docs: The operator of the first true message carrying it, which takes the
fee; default until one does.

fields.name: fee_taken
docs: The fee was taken; the record keeps stating it.

types.name: Stake
docs: The deposits one address put down on each side of one claim.
